caption: A ball rolls out of a room past a wall mirror, and its reflection leaves the mirror at the same time.

sa.check: A ball rolls out of a room past a wall mirror.
Its reflection leaves the mirror at the same time.
The mirror hangs on a wall.

pc.expect: The reflection slides out of the frame as the ball passes the mirror's edge, at the same time.
pc.fail: The reflection remains after the ball has gone; or leaves before the ball reaches the edge; or stays still while the ball rolls.

pc.expect: After the ball has passed, the mirror shows only the empty room.
pc.fail: A ball remains in the mirror; or a second ball appears; or the room in the mirror changes.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image of the ball, same colour and size.
pc.fail: It is a different colour or size; or a different object; or it is not mirrored.

pc.expect: The ball rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or restarts.

pc.expect: One ball and one mirror; the reflection stays in the mirror.
pc.fail: The reflection steps out; or the ball passes into the glass; or the ball vanishes; or the mirror duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the frame changes; or the room rearranges.
